value.signature: fn to_secret_canonical_bytes (& self , maximum : usize) -> Result < SecretBox < Vec < u8 > > , SecretEncodingLimit >

review.body: { let capacity = private_capacity (self , maximum) ? ; let mut output = SecretBox :: new (Box :: new (Vec :: with_capacity (capacity))) ; encode_protected (self , & mut output) ; Ok (output) }
review.item_premise: Protected canonical encoding or erasure inherits the secret-typed boundary; no private bytes become ordinary observed arguments.
